title: Candice Question Event
description: A structured governed question from the active Claude Code session (Spec Protocol, Kaizen, ELI5, or Bro) to be displayed and/or spoken by the Candice Companion. The companion is a surface only: it never rewrites question order or rules, and never creates a second AI conversation. Contract root: Candice Master Spec section 14. Version: 1.0.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this event schema. Bumped by the integration/release owner only (manifest 9.4 class 2); consumers reject unknown versions.

sessionId.description: Opaque Claude Code session identifier. Routing authority: answers must return to the same session that asked. Never derived from window position or host window.

skill.description: The supported BlackCEO skill that invoked Candice.

event.description: Event discriminator for the shared envelope.

questionKey.description: Stable machine-enumerable key, fixed for the life of the contract (see question-keys.json). Never re-asked: the same key is never sent again to the same session once answered.

text.description: Display and spoken wording of the question.

answerKind.description: How the answer is validated before it is returned to the owning session.

allowedInputModes.description: Which answer paths are permitted for this question. 'terminal' is Answer-in-Claude: the same question falls back to the terminal input surface without losing state and without double-counting.

readAloud.description: False for secret-bearing questions: the companion must never speak them aloud (captions still show regardless of voice state).

sensitivity.description: 'secret' forbids read-aloud and any logging of the answer; 'personal' forbids read-aloud unless the user opts in.

counted.description: True when this question counts toward the governed question ceiling. Answer-in-Claude must not double-count: a fallback to terminal is the same counted question, never a second ask.

current.description: Question ordinal, spoken as 'Question N of no more than C'.

ceiling.description: Stated question ceiling C, fixed at interview start and never moved silently.

shortcut.description: Expected landing count T (usually fewer than C). Null when C and T are within two and the single-number form is spoken.

progress.description: Real interview progress only. Never invented percentages: percentages come from status events, not from the question event.

helpText.description: Optional plain-language guidance for the question.

options.description: Optional allowed choices for single_choice or mode_choice answer kinds.

validation.description: Optional answer validation hints enforced by the companion before return.

canGoBack.description: Whether the user may return to a previously answered governed question.
